facts.fact: The World Bank PID says the pre-hospital emergency service (SAMU) relies on paper reports, lacks centralised data collection and does not integrate with hospital and electronic health record systems; the health system is largely paper-based and the DMI electronic record pilot has connectivity and functionality issues. Date is the document's published date.
